standard_prerequisites.name: The base change map for RHom is characterized by the adjunction formula relating it to the tensor-internal-hom diagonal map
standard_prerequisites.use: Matches the restricted map with the diagonal map of the next lemma.

standard_prerequisites.name: The tensor-internal-hom diagonal map K tensor RHom(M, L) -> RHom(M, K tensor L) is an isomorphism when K is perfect, R' is perfect over R, the map is flat with K pseudo-coherent and M bounded below, or R' has finite tor dimension with K pseudo-coherent and M bounded below
standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies the isomorphism in each of the four listed cases.

core_obligations: Both sides of the base change map live in D(R'), and restriction D(R') -> D(R) is conservative on isomorphisms, so it suffices to check after restriction (proof lines 28839-28841). Under restriction the map becomes RHom_R(K, L) tensor R' -> RHom_R(K, L tensor R'), which is the tensor-internal-hom diagonal map of the internal-hom-diagonal-better lemma; the matching of the left and right sides with the terms of that lemma is exactly the adjunction recorded by the upgrade-adjoint-tensor-RHom lemma (proof lines 28842-28851). The internal-hom-evaluate-tensor-isomorphism lemma asserts this diagonal map is an isomorphism precisely under the four hypotheses listed, which are exactly the hypotheses of the statement, so the base change map is an isomorphism in each case (proof lines 28851-28852).
proof_roadmap: Reduce to the restriction D(R') -> D(R) and identify the restricted map with the tensor-internal-hom diagonal map (proof lines 28839-28847).
Match the sides via the adjunction and conclude with the evaluate-tensor isomorphism under the four hypotheses (proof lines 28851-28852).
difficulty_reason: 15 行、RHom 的基变换相容性（四情形）：限制函子 D(R') -> D(R) 检验同构；限制后的映射恰是 internal-hom-diagonal-better 引理的张量-内积对角映射，两侧的对应由 upgrade-adjoint-tensor-RHom 引理的邻接式给出；再由 internal-hom-evaluate-tensor-isomorphism 引理在四个假设（K 完美 / R' 完美 / 平坦+伪凝聚+D+ / 有限 tor 维+伪凝聚+D+）下该对角映射是同构，故基变换映射是同构。承重全在 span 内；4 处引用作导航桩。
